text: Wealthy nations should always provide assistance to developing countries. Discuss this view.
Reading and telling stories to young children is very important. Examine this statement. [30]
Possessing nuclear weapons is the best way for a country to avoid war. Evaluate
this statement. [30]
A painting does not capture life as successfully as a photograph. Discuss. [30]
The only purpose of education is to obtain good qualifications. Evaluate this claim. [30]
‘The role of men in bringing up children is essential in modern society.’ Discuss. [30]
‘The effects of natural disasters have become more severe due to human activity.’ To what extent
do you agree? [30]
‘Scientific research intended to benefit human health should not face any restrictions.’ Discuss.
Advertising has a very negative impact on society. Evaluate this view. [30]
Artificial intelligence is changing people’s lives for the better. To what extent do you agree with
this statement? [30]
